'''Jheeg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] who lived on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He worked as a paid contact for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], keeping tabs on the criminal underworld and, when necessary, supplying Intelligence agents with false identities. His security clearance within the organization, however, was very low.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Jheeg provided an [[Imperial Agent]], later known as [[Cipher Nine]], a cover identity as the pirate, the [[Red Blade]], to infiltrate [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] organization. However, as soon as Nine's mission was complete, Jheeg informed the agent that the real Red Blade was on Hutta searching for his impostor, and advised haste in intercepting Blade.

The [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|former Minister of Intelligence]] would later use Jheeg's name as a cover when contacting [[Cipher Nine]] on the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].
